data.action: 侧身斜倚在研讨会休息室真皮沙发上，黑色毛衣领口自然拉至肩侧，修长双腿包裹黑丝优雅交叠于沙发，金红光环微倾，目光含蓄凝望
data.camera: cowboy shot, reclining on sofa, eye level, soft warm lighting
data.description: 研讨会高层专属休息室内，莉音神态从容地斜倚在深色真皮沙发上。宽松的黑色针织毛衣滑落单侧香肩，展现出优雅分明的锁骨与白皙肌肤。黑色百褶短裙下，包裹在透肉黑丝中的修长双腿在沙发边缘自然交叠，黑色高跟鞋轻搭垫旁。红宝石般的眼眸在落地暖灯与窗外城市霓虹交错下，卸去白日的锐利防备，流露出只属于此刻的温柔。
data.promptProse: Tsukatsuki Rio reclining gracefully on a sleek black leather sofa, black knit sweater slipping off one shoulder revealing her delicate collarbone, wearing a black pleated skirt and sheer black pantyhose with crossed legs, red geometric halo glowing softly, ruby-red eyes, looking at viewer with calm affection, panoramic city night view, warm ambient floor lamp.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 沙发高领毛衣半褪
data.animaCaption: She reclines on the dark leather sofa in an off-shoulder black sweater with crossed pantyhose legs.
